levels.name: Back-to-School Basecamp
levels.detail: Match early letters and sounds, read short-vowel words, identify nouns, and practice the first Tricky Words.
levels.learningTarget: I can match letters and sounds and read early Unit 1 words.

levels.name: Code Trail
levels.detail: Practice more consonants, all five short vowels, sister sounds, decoding, nouns, and new Tricky Words.
levels.learningTarget: I can use more letter sounds and short vowels to read words.

levels.name: Digraph Crossing
levels.detail: Read and spell words with ch, sh, th, ng, and qu while practicing new Tricky Words.
levels.learningTarget: I can read words with consonant digraphs and qu.

levels.name: Spelling Ridge
levels.detail: Review vowels and consonants and read words with ck and double-letter spellings.
levels.learningTarget: I can choose the correct spelling for sounds in one-syllable words.

levels.name: Sentence Springs
levels.detail: Read later Tricky Words and practice nouns, questions, question marks, and quotation marks.
levels.learningTarget: I can read Tricky Words and choose the correct punctuation.

levels.name: Unit 1 Summit
levels.detail: Climb through a complete review of Unit 1 sounds, spellings, words, Tricky Words, grammar, and punctuation.
levels.learningTarget: I can use everything I learned in Unit 1 to read words and sentences.
